ops.title: Mac runner, Namespace and AWS cost study: what mac-capacity-1 gathered before it stood down
ops.body:
mac-capacity-1 stood down on the Mac runner, Namespace and AWS cost study by owner order m222.5. Nothing below was posted to him; no card was drawn. What was gathered, for whoever takes it:

What held release 12470's Mac build (cci #389427, #389558): lanes held 4 then 5 of the 8 macOS slots (48 vCPU / 112 GiB workspace limit, 6x14 shape) while CI's mac queue ran on the rest; the sandsql-journal darwin job got no Namespace instance for 33 min. A second cause: Namespace retries a missed create slowly (prebuild 13568's warm job sat 40 min with no instance while the pool read 42/48; cancel plus retry got it a runner in 2.6 min).

Seven days of Namespace history (Oct 28 to Nov 3, 9,431 instances, data in ~/.vcache/scratch/mac-capacity-1: hist7d.json, week.py, report.csv): CI runners 9,313 instances, 469 instance-hours, lifetime median 121 s, p90 388 s. Hand-made Mac boxes (lanes, devboxes, manual) 71 boxes, 468 instance-hours: as much Mac time as CI. Many ran out their full 12 h or 24 h duration. Concurrent boxes, CI only: mean 2.8, p50 3, p90 5, p99 8, max 11; all boxes: mean 5.6, p90 8, max 13.

Namespace quote (PDF 'Namespace Poetic offer October 29, 2026', in amberjack/.orca/drops): unsigned, valid until Nov 3 2026, effective Oct 7 2026, 12 months, auto-renew, prepaid yearly. POETIC 2,500,000+ package $37,680/yr (list $54,924): 2.5M unit minutes a month included ($2,300/mo), overage $0.0015 per unit minute, macOS concurrency 120 vCPU / 280 GB RAM with 50% dedicated and 50% burstable (today's limit is 48 vCPU), 200,000 devbox minutes ($700/mo), 500 GB-month persistent volumes ($92/mo), 2,500 builds, 250 GB-month registry ($48/mo). Enterprise Support $3,000/yr. Total $40,680/yr.

Unverified, check before using: the macOS unit-minute multiplier (a third-party site says 10x per vCPU-minute; Namespace's docs say only that macOS bills above Linux; an instance bills only while it runs a job, minimum 1 minute); AWS EC2 Mac Dedicated Host rates (a third party lists mac-m4.metal at $1.23/h on demand; billing is per second with a 24-hour minimum allocation, Savings Plans up to 44% off; no official per-hour rate was read). `nsc instance report` gives per-instance started_at and destroyed_at for billable-time math but printed only a header for macOS in the window tried.

Shipped instead: cc-skills#2534 (MacWaits supervisor note and the macOS count on lr nsc create).
